Everything I ate at the Train Night Market in Bangkok! 🚂🍜🔥 📍Train Night Market Srinagarindra, Bangkok, Thailand 🇹🇭 #nightmarket #foodmarket #bangkok #thailand #streetfood
transcript:
WEBVTT


00:00:00.100 --> 00:00:03.300
This is everything I ate at the Train Night Market in Bangkok.

00:00:03.301 --> 00:00:05.021
There was so many food options to choose from,

00:00:05.022 --> 00:00:07.221
like this jumping shrimp. But this store caught my eye.

00:00:07.222 --> 00:00:09.261
I grabbed these two dollar fried chicken tenders,

00:00:09.262 --> 00:00:10.941
which were crispy with a soft chew.

00:00:10.942 --> 00:00:13.101
I loved adding fermented shrimp sauce on top,

00:00:13.102 --> 00:00:15.781
which added a salty and kind of funky kick in a good way.

00:00:15.782 --> 00:00:18.421
Next, I tried this 4 dollar Buddha carbonara omelette,

00:00:18.422 --> 00:00:20.701
which was topped with sea weed and a fried egg.

00:00:20.702 --> 00:00:23.341
It was spicy and a little creamy with a runny egg yolk.

00:00:23.342 --> 00:00:24.981
Some cheese would make this even better.

00:00:24.982 --> 00:00:27.421
Then I got this four dollar mochi where you can pick kill feeling.

00:00:27.422 --> 00:00:29.621
So I added strawberry cream cheese and grapes.

00:00:29.622 --> 00:00:30.741
I love the concept of this,

00:00:30.742 --> 00:00:33.621
but the mochi itself was just missing that chewy texture I love.

00:00:33.622 --> 00:00:34.941
It was quite gummy and soft,

00:00:34.942 --> 00:00:35.981
but the feeling was not bad.

00:00:35.982 --> 00:00:37.941
I also got this $3 snail salad,

00:00:37.942 --> 00:00:40.381
which had an addictive soft crunch and chewiness.

00:00:40.382 --> 00:00:41.021
The chilli,

00:00:41.022 --> 00:00:44.461
lime and onions just gave it a really fresh and tangy burst of flavour

00:00:44.462 --> 00:00:45.061
I like. Oh,

00:00:45.062 --> 00:00:47.501
my favourite bite turned out to be the cheapest item,

00:00:47.502 --> 00:00:49.381
which were these 50 cent beef skewers.

00:00:49.382 --> 00:00:50.941
They were smokey, spicy,

00:00:50.942 --> 00:00:53.861
a little fatty and juicy. I reckon I could smash out like 10 of these.

00:00:53.862 --> 00:00:56.141
And when in Thailand, you've got to get Thai milk tea.

00:00:56.142 --> 00:00:57.741
This guy showed me his baby squirrel.

00:00:57.742 --> 00:01:00.581
Anyways, the two dollar Thai milk Tea was refreshing and not too sweet.

00:01:00.582 --> 00:01:02.981
And finally, I got this three dollar banana roti,

00:01:02.982 --> 00:01:05.701
which was golden and caramelized and coated in Nutella.

00:01:05.702 --> 00:01:08.781
It was wonderfully crispy and the banana inside was soft and gooey.

00:01:08.782 --> 00:01:09.940
This was a sweet end to the night.

description: Let me put you guys on this spot serving up extremely delicious nashville hot chicken! They just opened up their 2nd location in mississauga and brought out some new menu items that are worth trying. Just make sure to get the mac n cheese and thank me later!  📍THGS Hot Chicken  #hotchicken #chicken #bestchicken #nashvillehotchicken #chickentenders #comfortfood #soulfood #viral #viralfood #toronto #torontofood
transcript:
WEBVTT


00:00:00.100 --> 00:00:01.940
Am I in Nashville or Mississauga?

00:00:01.941 --> 00:00:05.101
Because I just found one of the best hot chicken joints in the GTA.

00:00:05.102 --> 00:00:07.381
Starting off strong with these hand breaded chicken wings.

00:00:07.382 --> 00:00:10.861
These were crazy. And these are jumbo wings loaded with so much meat.

00:00:10.862 --> 00:00:12.421
And that's what I call a clean pull.

00:00:12.422 --> 00:00:13.581
One bite, no meat,

00:00:13.582 --> 00:00:14.661
just perfection.

00:00:14.662 --> 00:00:18.161
But my favorite so far has to be their homemade creamy Mac and cheese.

00:00:18.180 --> 00:00:20.140
And if your Mac and cheese doesn't look like this,

00:00:20.141 --> 00:00:20.941
I don't want it.

00:00:20.942 --> 00:00:24.021
They absolutely load up the container high up to the sky.

00:00:24.022 --> 00:00:25.781
Then he puts the hot honey chicken.

00:00:25.782 --> 00:00:29.021
Holy with the sauted onion and peppers.

00:00:29.022 --> 00:00:31.341
Flavor combination is something I never had before.

00:00:31.342 --> 00:00:32.821
And this was game over for me.

00:00:32.822 --> 00:00:34.421
The ultimate soul comfort.

00:00:34.422 --> 00:00:37.181
But it was finally time to try the Nashville hot Chicken.

00:00:37.182 --> 00:00:39.421
And just look at these gigantic chicken tenders.

00:00:39.422 --> 00:00:40.541
It was crispy, tender,

00:00:40.542 --> 00:00:42.901
juicy and loaded up with so much Nashville spice.

00:00:42.902 --> 00:00:44.861
But what do you know about chicken and waffle

00:00:44.862 --> 00:00:46.301
and the mozzarella cheese sticks?

00:00:46.302 --> 00:00:49.785
So definitely check this spot out and follow me for more food content.

THIS IS YOUR SIGN to have a party at Rainforest Cafe!!! Thank you for hosting us for the most unforgettable night @Rainforest Cafe  this was the greatest surprise I could ask for 🐸 And thank you to the beautiful friends who grabbed their animal print and hopped onboard so last minute for a much needed nostalgic adventure!!!  #rainforestcafe #kitsch #nostalgiacore
transcript:
WEBVTT


00:00:00.080 --> 00:00:02.880
the internet keeps telling me that Rainforest Cafe is dying

00:00:02.881 --> 00:00:04.521
so I did what any Kitch loving

00:00:04.522 --> 00:00:06.001
nostalgia seeking girl would do

00:00:06.002 --> 00:00:07.841
and I called an emergency meeting with my friends

00:00:07.842 --> 00:00:10.321
to take a trip for a belated birthday Celebration

00:00:10.322 --> 00:00:11.041
before we left I

00:00:11.042 --> 00:00:11.441
of course

00:00:11.442 --> 00:00:14.441
gave a slideshow presentation about the history of Rainforest Cafe

00:00:14.442 --> 00:00:17.081
because I wanted them to feel the weight of this establishment

00:00:17.082 --> 00:00:19.561
within our culture and then we were off to Ontario

00:00:19.562 --> 00:00:21.481
California a bit of a drive from Orange County

00:00:21.482 --> 00:00:24.521
but very beautiful views the excitement was already through the roof

00:00:24.522 --> 00:00:26.361
and we did not even know what we were in for

00:00:26.362 --> 00:00:28.121
first of all this is inside of a giant mall

00:00:28.122 --> 00:00:29.801
like many Rainforest Cafes are

00:00:29.802 --> 00:00:31.041
and their branding and decor

00:00:31.042 --> 00:00:33.281
starts long before you even reach the entrance

00:00:33.282 --> 00:00:35.281
now this is where the surprises really started

00:00:35.282 --> 00:00:37.701
because for one thank goodness we had a reservation

00:00:37.840 --> 00:00:39.040
there was a line out the door

00:00:39.041 --> 00:00:42.361
not only that our table was completely decorated with hats

00:00:42.362 --> 00:00:44.321
balloon flowers themed glasses

00:00:44.322 --> 00:00:45.561
binoculars I mean

00:00:45.562 --> 00:00:47.401
it was decked out for our party

00:00:47.402 --> 00:00:49.521
while everyone is freaking out and taking it all in

00:00:49.522 --> 00:00:52.121
I get gifted with a heart balloon crown

00:00:52.122 --> 00:00:53.721
so I haven't even sat down yet

00:00:53.722 --> 00:00:55.241
and these people have already made my night

00:00:55.242 --> 00:00:56.001
I look around

00:00:56.002 --> 00:00:58.841
everyone is immediately putting on their temporary tattoos

00:00:58.842 --> 00:01:00.681
then Cha Cha shows up to say hi

00:01:00.682 --> 00:01:03.681
they bring out appetizers that were so freaking good

00:01:03.682 --> 00:01:06.241
and did I mention the place is packed

00:01:06.242 --> 00:01:09.081
certainly not giving the energy of a dying restaurant

00:01:09.082 --> 00:01:10.441
and while we waited for the entrees

00:01:10.442 --> 00:01:13.081
there was so much to take in and enjoy

00:01:13.082 --> 00:01:15.761
from the decor to the simulated thunderstorms

00:01:15.762 --> 00:01:18.321
to the balloon animal artists walking around the place

00:01:18.322 --> 00:01:21.121
I was in heaven the food was 10 out of 10

00:01:21.122 --> 00:01:23.041
it was flavorful and delicious

00:01:23.042 --> 00:01:24.321
everyone was raving about it

00:01:24.322 --> 00:01:27.441
after not having been to a Rainforest Cafe in about 30 years

00:01:27.442 --> 00:01:28.601
I can confidently say

00:01:28.602 --> 00:01:31.641
my six year old self would be shaking if she could see me now

00:01:31.642 --> 00:01:34.121
like this night could not have been more perfect

00:01:34.122 --> 00:01:36.321
we obviously hit up the iconic gift shop on the way out

00:01:36.322 --> 00:01:37.201
and as we were leaving

00:01:37.202 --> 00:01:40.201
I couldn't help but reflect on how this experience was such a relief

00:01:40.202 --> 00:01:43.241
from the usual jungle that I am navigating out here in the real world

00:01:43.242 --> 00:01:43.921
you know what I mean

00:01:43.922 --> 00:01:46.181
so this is officially your sign to make the reservation

00:01:46.240 --> 00:01:49.300
go hit up the rainforest you will have a wild time
